skills.name: First Form: Thunderclap and Flash (壱ノ型・霹靂一閃)
skills.description:
This can only be used if Zenitsu is in his Thunder Breathing state.
Zenitsu attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK and gains 5 stacks of Thunderclap at the end of turn. When there are no non-summoned allies other than himself, these Thunderclap stacks can be gained a total of 5 more times. ;Thunder Breathing (雷の呼吸) : :'''Buff, Mark''': When Zenitsu has 6 stacks of Thunderclap, he becomes immune to Sleep. ;Thunderclap (霹靂) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 6 stacks. When Zenitsu receives damage or is inflicted with a control effect, consumes 1 stack to grant him immunity to those effects on that turn. Immunity can be granted up to a max of 5 times.

skills.name: Sleeping Zenitsu (善逸昏睡)
skills.description: At the start of Zenitsu's turn, he will permanently enter his Thunder Breathing state. The skills First Form: Thunderclap and Flash and First Form: Thunderclap and Flash Sixfold will also become unlocked. ;Thunder Breathing (雷の呼吸) : :'''Buff, Mark''': When Zenitsu has 6 stacks of Thunderclap, he becomes immune to Sleep. ;Thunderclap (霹靂) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 6 stacks. When Zenitsu receives damage or is inflicted with a control effect, consumes 1 stack to grant him immunity to those effects on that turn. Immunity can be granted up to a max of 5 times.

upgrades.text: Boost to move bar increases to 6%.
Boost to move bar increases to 9%.
Boost to move bar increases to 12%.
Boost to move bar increases to 15%.

skills.name: First Form: Thunderclap and Flash Sixfold (壱ノ型・霹靂一閃・六連)
skills.description:
This can only be used if Zenitsu is in his Thunder Breathing state.
Zenitsu attacks the enemy, dealing damage equal to 64% of his ATK to random enemies. The number of attacks is equal to the number of Thunderclap stacks he has. Then he attacks targeted enemy, dealing damage equal to 256% of his ATK. ; : ;Thunder Breathing (雷の呼吸) : :'''Buff, Mark''': When Zenitsu has 6 stacks of Thunderclap, he becomes immune to Sleep. ;Thunderclap (霹靂) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 6 stacks. When Zenitsu receives damage or is inflicted with a control effect, consumes 1 stack to grant him immunity to those effects on that turn. Immunity can be granted up to a max of 5 times.

upgrades.text: When 1 or more non-summoned enemies remain, damage for the targeted attack increases by 5%.
When 2 or more non-summoned enemies remain, damage for the targeted attack increases by 20%.
When 3 or more non-summoned enemies remain, damage for the targeted attack increases by 30%.
When 4 or more non-summoned enemies remain, damage for the targeted attack increases by 30%.
